newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise wins Moroccan power contract.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise wins Moroccan power contract.

text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux said it was heading a European consortium that won a 30-year power and water distribution deal from Morocco's Casablanca city council.
In a statement Lyonnaise put total investments involved at 18 billion francs (30 billion dirhams) and sales generated during the first year of operation at 2.1 billion francs.
"Lyonnaise des Eaux de Casablanca", the company set up to take over management of water, electricity and public waste, has a starting capital of 800 million dirhams (480 million francs).
Lyonnaise des Eaux will own 35 percent of the capital, its Elyo unit 24 percent, EDF International 18 percent, Endesar 18 percent and Aguas de Barcelona five percent.
The capital may later be opened to Moroccan investors and financial institutions.
